prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the green stone terraces of Machu Picchu with stone steps of normal height and low terrace walls, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Lebanese woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in low bun, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large copper hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a bronze cube-shaped block, a gold ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten platinum necklaces. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

RIGHT Physique: A very tall, slim, long-limbed man with a runway build. Straight shoulders, a flat lean chest, a flat defined stomach, slender strong arms and very long legs, lightly muscled and elegant, with visible collarbones and a narrow waist. His head stays in correct proportion to his long frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions), wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense floral medallion border filling the space between every band. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet.
